newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan CANTV's unions may yet strike over pay.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan CANTV's unions may yet strike over pay.

text.p: Venezuela's Federation of Telecommunication workers (Fetratel) said it may yet come out in strike to pressure the national phone company CANTV for a 120 percent pay rise.
"That's not to say we will ... but if the company doesn't respect our proposals action may be taken, only led by Fetratel," Fetratel president Cruz Hernandez told Reuters.
Fetratel groups 29 different unions employed by CANTV.
On Tuesday, one of those, the workers union in the central Federal District (Caracas) and Miranda states, threatened to strike over a "petty 20 percent pay offer".
Company officials told Reuters earlier Wednesday they were not worried by that threat, which was by a union not party to scheduled 1997-1998 wage contract negotiations between labor and management.
Company sources added the pay offer, after including bonuses and other benefits, was 66 percent.
